introHtml: Small-size pants and shorts are essential for youth teams, petite staff, or anyone needing a trimmer fit. Whether you're branding Gildan sweatpants for a school program or custom jogger shorts for a corporate 5K, small sizes ensure your logo sits well without excess fabric. Screen printing and embroidery both work great on these compact cuts, giving you a polished look that fits right.
